text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Application Form * 2. Proof of Non-Criminal Record * 3. Two letters of recommendation in Chinese or English from whom can attest to the quality of the applicant’s academic performance and scholastic potential. The letters must include recommenders’ phone number and email address.If the letters cannot be uploaded by the applicant, the applicant can send the link in the system to the recommender for filling in the letter. 4. Other materials Applicants may submit additional documents which may demonstrate comprehensive abilities along with the required documents, such as award certificates o rpublished papers. * 5. English proficiency test certificate Original or notarized copyof TOEFL (IBT) score of 90 or above or IELTS (Academic) score 6.5 or above or Duolingo score of 110 or above or PTE Academic score of 61 or above, taken within two years prior to application date (only for applicants from non-English speaking countries), students from high school with major courses taught in English maybe waiveredof TOEFLor IELTS requirements. * 6. High School Full Transcript Original or notarized copy, with notarized Chinese or English translation, if original not in Chinese or English. * 7. High School Diploma Applicants in their final year of high school study shall provide the expected graduation certificate(Original or notarized copy, with notarized Chinese or English translation, if original not in Chinese or English). * 8. Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Only ordinary passports are accepted and the expiry date should be after March1, 2027. * 9. Passport-sized photos Three passport-sized photos (photo must have been taken within the past six months. * 10. Statement of personal financial capacity or financial support You can download a template or sample from here . * 11. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
